COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
C528 No.1286 of 2025
With
(Interim Relief Appl. No.01 of 2025)
Hon’ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Vikas Kumar Guglani, learned counsel 
for the Applicants.
2. Mr. Akshay Latwal, learned AGA for the 
State. 
3. Present C528 Application has been filed by 
the Applicants for quashing the entire proceedings, 
charge sheet dated 01.03.2025 and the cognizance 
order dated 28.05.2025 for the offence punishable 
under Section 420, 323, 506 and 120-B of IPC in 
Criminal Case No.225 of 2025 State of Uttarakhand 
vs. Paramjeet Singh and other pending in the court 
of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Champawat, 
District Champawat. 
4. Admit.
5. Issue notice to the Respondent no.3 
returnable at an early date.
6. Steps be taken within one week.
7. Let the objection be filed by the State within 
two weeks.
8. List on 26.09.2025.
9. Having heard learned counsel for the parties, 
as an interim measure, till the next date of listing, 
entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.225 of 2025 
State of Uttarakhand vs. Paramjeet Singh and others
for the offence punishable under Section 420, 323, 
506 and 120-B of IPC pending in the court of 
learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Champawat, 
District Champawat qua the applicants shall remain 
stayed.
10. Interim relief application stands disposed of.
 (Ashish Naithani, J.) 05.08.2025
